# Check If String Is a Prefix of Array.

@example After the first three pieces the text is "sunflower"; the fourth piece isn't needed.
"sunflower"
["sun","flow","er","seed"]
=> true

@example The text is "pan" after one piece and "pancakes" after two; "pancake" would end inside the second piece.
"pancake"
["pan","cakes"]
=> false

@example All the pieces together give only "bluebi": the message ends before s is complete.
"bluebird"
["blue","bi"]
=> false

# The shortest s: the first word alone is s, and a word is left over.
"x"
["x","yz"]
=> true

# s stops one letter into a word.
"abc"
["ab","cd"]
=> false

# s is the start of the first word (comparing the whole word with s
# reads past the end of s).
"ca"
["catalog"]
=> false

# s takes every word (k = words.length).
"onetwothree"
["one","two","three"]
=> true

# The words run out before s does, though all of them match.
"onetwothreex"
["one","two","three"]
=> false

# The right words in the wrong order.
"redcar"
["car","red"]
=> false

# s is made of words that are not at the front.
"ij"
["x","i","j"]
=> false

# Only the last letter differs.
"hotdog"
["hot","dot"]
=> false

# Only the first word differs.
"hotdog"
["pot","dog"]
=> false

# The same word several times in a row.
"abab"
["ab","ab","ab"]
=> true

# Random small cases from gen.c (lc check --regen makes them).
@gen 1 small
"bbbbbabaa"
["bb","bbb","ab","aaa"]
=> false

@gen 2 small
"aa"
["aa","a"]
=> true

@gen 3 small
"aab"
["aab"]
=> true

@gen 4 small
"aba"
["a","b","aa","aaa"]
=> false

@gen 5 small
"ababb"
["ab","a","b","ba","ba"]
=> false

@gen 6 small
"abbabaaa"
["ba","abb"]
=> false
